map.role: monolithic body and carved face (brow, nose, lips, chin, torso)
map.rationale: The dominant column reads as one smooth, uniform, matte gray mass — clean weathered tuff with no coursing or grain. The stepped facial planes are carved FROM this same monolith (geometry, not a material change), so the whole figure is a single smooth gray field.

The stepped cap at the crown is the one warm note — a muted reddish-orange with faint horizontal coursing, distinct in both hue and material from the gray body; red sandstone's warm tone and bedded grain match the historically-correct pukao.

Near-tone but NOT the same material as the body: the base shows a regular tiled grid / coursed jointing in all three views, versus the smooth jointless concrete of the column. Kept distinct as bricks (visible coursing, masonry role as a wider footing) rather than collapsed into the body's gray.
